PassiveDesc.Name: Change of Rules
PassiveDesc.Desc: Pages are exhausted on use, and are recycled if the deck is empty. At the start of the Scene, recover all Light. After rolling a die, give all dice on the Combat Page roll value equal to its roll value.

PassiveDesc.Name: Change of Rules
PassiveDesc.Desc: At the start of each Scene, an ally with 'Change of Rules' gain a Speed Dice Slot (max one, in reverse unit order).

PassiveDesc.Name: LCB Sinner Gregor
PassiveDesc.Desc: Uncontrollable. Instead of being defeated, becomes Staggered until HP rises above one.

PassiveDesc.Name: Forced Survival
PassiveDesc.Desc: At the start of the Scene, recover 5 HP and Stagger Resist.

PassiveDesc.Name: Gene Code G-0
PassiveDesc.Desc: Upon starting Combat, the ally with the least HP recovers 5 HP and Stagger Resist.

PassiveDesc.Name: LCB Member Yuri
PassiveDesc.Desc: Uncontrollable. Instead of being defeated, becomes Staggered until HP rises above one.

PassiveDesc.Name: Resolution
PassiveDesc.Desc: At the start of the Scene, gain 2 Haste if the unit has 4+ Poise.

PassiveDesc.Name: Backing
PassiveDesc.Desc: Upon starting Combat, before rolling dice on the first Combat Page slotted by the ally with the highest Aggro, opposing dice lose 1 power.

PassiveDesc.Name: Cracked Gold
PassiveDesc.Desc: At the start of the Act, gain 3 Golden Sheen (At the start of the Scene, heal 10 HP for each stack if not Staggered).
